definition: Monotonic seconds from issuing the pod delete request to the first poll that lists a pod with a new UID matching namespace+selector. Kubernetes object existence only; upper bound with one poll interval of resolution; includes kubectl start-up and API latency.

Monotonic seconds from the first poll that lists the replacement pod to the first poll that shows its Ready condition True. Kubernetes readiness only, NOT ROS application recovery; resolution of one poll interval (0 = already Ready when first seen).
Replacement metadata.creationTimestamp (API-server clock, 1 s resolution) minus the local wall-clock time of the delete request. Affected by clock skew; null if negative.
Ready condition lastTransitionTime minus replacement creationTimestamp, both Kubernetes timestamps with 1 s resolution. Auxiliary; readiness only; null if negative.
Time of the replacement pod's Scheduled event minus its creationTimestamp. Scheduling only. Events are best-effort and may be missing. No Started event is used anywhere.
Seconds from disruption to the first ROS message restored, taken from a supplied message probe on the probe's own clock. NOT MEASURED unless a probe input is supplied.
